question: Should `sessions_list` permanently become the focused discovery-only model-facing contract that omits routing, timing, policy, and transcript-path fields from prior rows?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a currently returned tool-result shape; tests can verify the implementation but cannot decide the long-term compatibility and discoverability tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm the focused discovery contract
options.body: Keep the reduced row shape, document the supported detail-retrieval paths, and repair the `session_status` text projection before merge.

options.title: Preserve selected compatibility fields
options.body: Retain any fields needed for established model workflows and keep the remaining reduction limited to low-value internal or sensitive data.
